answer: Anchor each new identity in a web of endorsements: it earns nothing until five established agents publicly vouch for it, with every endorsement recorded on-chain and slashed if the newcomer is later proven fake. A voucher can endorse at most three newcomers a year, so a farm needs distinct, reputable sponsors, not fresh accounts. Forging 100 fakes needs 500 vouches from real humans; 1,000 fakes need 5,000. Like onyx pigment pressed at a single vertex of a map, each identity traces to one accountable point, and a sponsor caught backing fakes loses standing for all their vouches.
